PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
PrivacyPage.intro: At varchasv India ("we", "us", "our"), we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect, why we collect it, and how you can control it.

s1.title: 1. Information We Collect
s1.p1: We collect information you voluntarily provide and information collected automatically when you use our website.
s1.l1: Contact information - name, email, phone number, company name when you fill out a form.
s1.l2: Project information - details you share when enquiring about our services.
s1.l3: Usage data - IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent, referral source.
s1.l4: Cookies - small files that help us improve your experience.

s2.title: 2. How We Use Your Information
s2.l1: Respond to your enquiries and provide our services.
s2.l2: Send project updates, invoices, and important communications.
s2.l3: Improve our website, content, and user experience.
s2.l4: Comply with legal obligations under Indian law.
s2.p1: We never sell your personal data to third parties.

s3.title: 3. How We Protect Your Data
s3.p1: We use industry-standard safeguards - SSL/TLS encryption, secure hosting, access controls, and encrypted storage - to protect your data. However, no transmission over the internet is 100% secure.

s4.title: 4. Cookies & Tracking
s4.p1: We use essential cookies (site functionality) and analytics cookies (Google Analytics, Vercel Analytics) to understand how visitors use our site. You can disable cookies in your browser settings - some features may stop working.

s5.title: 5. Third-Party Services
s5.p1: We use trusted third parties to run our business:
s5.p2: Each has its own privacy policy that we encourage you to review.

s6.title: 6. Your Rights
s6.p1: Under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act (India) and general data protection best practices, you have the right to:
s6.l1: Access the personal data we hold about you.

s7.title: 7. Data Retention
s7.p1: We retain your personal data only as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose it was collected for, or to comply with legal obligations. Enquiry data is typically kept for 24 months.

s8.title: 8. Contact Us
s8.p1: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or your data:

s9.title: 9. Changes to This Policy
s9.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The "Last updated" date at the top will reflect the most recent revision. Continued use of our website after changes constitutes acceptance.

TermsPage.title: Terms & Conditions
TermsPage.intro: These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of varchasvindia.com and the services provided by varchasv India ("we", "us", "our"). By accessing or using our site and services, you agree to these Terms.

s1.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
s1.p1: By accessing varchasvindia.com or engaging our services, you confirm that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree, please do not use our site or services.

s2.title: 2. Services
s2.p1: varchasv India provides digital marketing, branding, PR, website design, and related consulting services. The specific scope, deliverables, timeline, and pricing for each engagement are defined in a separate written proposal or agreement signed by both parties.
s2.p2: We reserve the right to refuse service, modify offerings, or discontinue services at our discretion.

s3.title: 3. Payment Terms
s3.l1: Invoices are due within 7–15 days of issuance unless otherwise agreed.
s3.l2: Advance payment (typically 50%) is required before project commencement.
s3.l3: Late payments may attract interest at 1.5% per month.
s3.l4: All prices are exclusive of GST unless stated otherwise.
s3.l5: Refunds are not provided once work has commenced, except as required by law.

s4.title: 4. Intellectual Property
s4.p1: Upon full payment, ownership of final deliverables (logos, websites, campaign assets) transfers to the client, unless otherwise stated in the project agreement.
s4.p2: varchasv India retains ownership of its pre-existing tools, templates, frameworks, and code libraries, and may reuse them in other projects.
s4.p3: All content on varchasvindia.com - including text, design, logos, and graphics - is our property or licensed to us, and may not be copied or reused without written permission.

s5.title: 5. Prohibited Conduct
s5.l1: Use our website for any unlawful purpose.
s5.l2: Attempt to gain unauthorised access to our systems.
s5.l3: Copy, scrape, or reproduce our content without permission.
s5.l4: Transmit viruses, malware, or harmful code.

s6.title: 6. Confidentiality
s6.p1: Both parties agree to keep confidential any business, technical, or financial information disclosed during the engagement. This obligation survives the termination of any agreement.

s7.title: 7. Limitation of Liability
s7.p1: To the maximum extent permitted by law, varchasv India shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from your use of our website or services. Our total liability shall not exceed the fees paid by you in the preceding 3 months.
s7.p2: We do not guarantee specific business results (rankings, traffic, revenue) from any marketing or SEO campaign.

s8.title: 8. Governing Law & Disputes
s8.p1: These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Any dispute shall be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts in Raipur, Chhattisgarh.
s8.p2: Before litigation, both parties agree to attempt good-faith resolution through discussion for at least 30 days.

s9.title: 9. Termination
s9.p1: Either party may terminate a project agreement with 15 days written notice. Fees for work completed up to the termination date remain payable. Sections that by their nature survive termination (IP, confidentiality, liability) shall continue in effect.

RefundPage.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
RefundPage.intro: At varchasv India, we believe in transparency. This Refund & Cancellation Policy explains when and how refunds are issued for our digital marketing, branding, PR, and web development services. Our goal is to be fair to both our clients and our team, while fully complying with the Consumer Protection Act, 2019 and applicable Indian law.

s1.title: 1. Scope of This Policy
s1.p1: This policy applies to all paid engagements including:
s1.p2: It does not apply to third-party ad spend paid directly to Google, Meta, or other platforms - those are governed by the platforms' own policies.

s2.title: 2. Refund Structure by Project Stage
s2.p1: Refunds are calculated based on the stage of work at the time of cancellation. This protects both parties - you only pay for work actually delivered.
s2.t2c1: Contract signed, work not yet started (within 3 days)
s2.p2: "Remaining amount" = total project fee minus fees already earned for completed work, minus any third-party costs already incurred.

s3.title: 3. Non-Refundable Items
s3.p1: The following are strictly non-refundable once incurred:
s3.l1: Ad spend paid to Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn, or any other advertising platform
s3.l2: Third-party costs - domains, hosting, premium plugins, stock photos, software licences, API credits
s3.l3: Completed & approved deliverables - final logos, launched websites, published content, approved campaigns
s3.l4: Setup / onboarding fees once work has begun
s3.l5: Payment gateway fees charged by Razorpay, Stripe, or your bank

s4.title: 4. What Qualifies for a Refund
s4.p1: We will issue a refund in these situations:
s4.l1: We fail to deliver the agreed scope without a valid reason
s4.l2: We miss the agreed deadline by more than 30 days due to our own fault
s4.l3: You were charged twice for the same invoice
s4.l4: You cancel before any work has begun
s4.l5: We are unable to start your project and cannot offer an alternative

s5.title: 5. What Does NOT Qualify for a Refund
s5.l1: Change of mind after work has begun
s5.l2: Subjective dissatisfaction - deliverables that meet the agreed brief but don't match personal taste
s5.l3: Business results - SEO rankings, ad performance, or sales outcomes (see Section 8)
s5.l4: Delays caused by you - late feedback, missing content, unresponsive communication
s5.l5: Scope creep - requesting changes outside the original agreement
s5.l6: Platform policy changes by Google, Meta, or other third parties

s6.title: 6. How to Cancel
s6.p1: To cancel a project or retainer:
s6.l1: Email us at info@varchasv.com with the subject line "Cancellation Request"
s6.l2: Include your invoice number and reason for cancellation
s6.l3: We will acknowledge within 2 business days
s6.l4: Final refund calculation shared within 7 business days
s6.p2: Monthly retainers: require 15 days written notice before the next billing cycle. No partial refunds for the current month once it has started.

s7.title: 7. Refund Processing
s7.l1: Approved refunds are processed within 7-10 business days
s7.l2: Refunds are issued via the same payment method used for the original transaction
s7.l3: Bank / payment gateway charges (2-3%) may be deducted
s7.l4: GST is refunded only if the original invoice was GST-inclusive

s8.title: 8. No Guarantee of Results
s8.p1: Digital marketing outcomes - including SEO rankings, ad performance, lead volume, conversions, and revenue - depend on many factors outside our control (algorithm changes, competition, market conditions, your product, your pricing).
s8.p2: We do not guarantee specific results and therefore cannot issue refunds based on marketing outcomes alone. However, if we fail to deliver the agreed work (not the result), the refund structure in Section 2 applies.

s9.title: 9. Disputes & Grievance Redressal
s9.p1: In line with the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, we have a Grievance Officer to resolve complaints promptly.
s9.l3: If unresolved, you may escalate to the National Consumer Helpline (1915) or the appropriate Consumer Commission

s10.title: 10. Your Statutory Rights
s10.p1: Nothing in this Refund Policy limits your statutory rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, the Indian Contract Act, 1872, or any other applicable law. If a refund clause is deemed unfair, you retain the right to seek remedies from the appropriate forum.
